Photo 1: The same appliance with cooked beans in the pot, indicating it can cook stews or legumes.
Photo 2: The appliance closed, showing the control knob and base. The knob has markings, but they are not legible. The pot contains rice, and the lid is partially open.
The appliance appears to be used, with some residue and stains visible on the inner pot and lid.
No brand or model name is visible on the appliance in any photo.
